subject: Routing plan + hotel split for Satellite Surge (Apr 24-26)
thread_text:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Routing plan + hotel split for Satellite Surge (Apr 24-26)

Team —

We need to lock routing and the hotel split for Satellite Surge next weekend. NeonStage confirmed 2 exhibitor-only rooms at Grand Harbor and has a small green room for field staff, but we need to spread the on-call rotations across two nearby properties to keep wake windows reasonable. High-level constraints:

- Show footprint: main hall open 07:30–18:00 Mon-Wed (setup on Sun night)
- Core coverage: 2 booth leads, 3 product demonstrators, 1 floater (backup), 1 on-call engineer per shift
- Travel windows: most folks arrive Sat night (23rd) or Sun morning (24th) — a couple of late red-eye flights are returning Wed night

Proposal attached: hotel_rooming_split.pdf (draft). Short asks:
1) Laura — can you confirm the two people who must be roomed at Grand Harbor (they need immediate access to the exhibitor dock)?
2) Aisha — please confirm flight pairings and whether we can get the 6:30 AM departures back to SFO on Wed.
3) Vivek — if someone drops, can you provide a local standby contact we can pull from Dedicated to cover the 10:00–14:00 demo shift?

I’ll put the on-call schedule in the sheet and share final rooming once people confirm.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
 (attachment: hotel_rooming_split.pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Routing plan + hotel split for Satellite Surge (Apr 24-26)

Marcus —

Confirmed: please prioritize room access for the booth leads, Priya N. and Diego F. (they need dock keys and early access for rigging). I recommend we put Priya and Diego at Grand Harbor. The rest of the booth crew can be split between Grand Harbor overflow (same block) and HarborView Suites (3 blocks away) to keep daily commutes under 12 minutes.

Notes:
- Priya Natarajan (booth lead) — early check-in requested (arrives Sat 23:45)
- Diego Fernandez (booth lead) — arrives Sun 07:10, needs a cart at dock

I'll update the rooming PDF with names and ship back.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Events Producer, Redwood Inference

From: ops@neonstage.com <ops@neonstage.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:40:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Routing plan + hotel split for Satellite Surge (Apr 24-26)

Hi Marcus/Laura —

Quick clarifications from venue side:
- Grand Harbor exhibitor rooms are available for early load-in staff with exhibitor badges only. They will hold two keys at Will Call for Priya and Diego.
- HarborView Suites is 12 minutes by bike; there is a luggage drop but no early rigging access.
- The green room is limited to 6 people at a time; if you need more space we can provide an additional storage cage on the dock for demo boxes.

Also — we have a backstage power run scheduled Sun 18:00–20:00. If your team needs access to test kits earlier, come by the dock at 18:15.

Best,
NeonStage Ops (attachment: dock_access_instructions.pdf)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:57:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Routing plan + hotel split for Satellite Surge (Apr 24-26)

All —

Flight update and pairings (booked via internal travel portal):
- Priya N. — SFO → PDX (arr Sat 23:10) / return PDX → SFO (Wed 21:10)
- Diego F. — SFO → PDX (arr Sun 07:10) / return PDX → SFO (Wed 18:30)
- Monica P. — SFO → PDX (arr Sun 06:45) / return Wed 17:55
- Vivek K. (standby) — arriving Sun midday, booked flexible ticket in case we need to shift to earlier duty
- Two demonstrators (Jonas W., Marissa C.) — Sat red-eye arrival and Sun morning respectively

I could only get three Wed evening seats on the 17:55–21:10 timeframe; Diego's return is slightly earlier. If anyone needs a different routing tell me by EOD Thu and I'll try swaps.

Attached: satellite_surge_oncall_schedule.xlsx (first pass) — contains shift blocks and phone-oncall order. Please confirm your highlighted cells.

Thanks,
Aisha
Senior Field Ops, Redwood Inference

Quick status and contingency:

- I confirmed a Dedicated pool engineer (Rohan M.) on standby locally — he can cover the 10:00–14:00 demo shift if we get a late sick call. He'll be reachable at +1-415-555-0129.
- If late returns force someone to miss the 17:00 teardown block, we should run a 2-person teardown instead of pulling extra headcount. That keeps demo coverage intact.
- Recommend Monica be primary contact for day-of staffing swaps; she's local and can pick up a replacement from a short list.

Vivek
Director, Field Delivery, Redwood Inference

All — finalizing:

- Grand Harbor: Priya N., Diego F. (booth leads) — keys at Will Call, early dock access OK
- HarborView Suites: Jonas W., Marissa C., two demonstrators (backup)
- Overflow rooms (one-night only): Vivek K., Monica P. (for equipment staging)

On-call rotation (see attached schedule) — we've shifted one demo block so Rohan M. (standby) only needs to be available Mon 10:00–14:00.

Day-of phone tree:
- Primary: Monica Patel — +1-415-555-0199
- Secondary: Laura Bennett — +1-650-555-0172
- Venue ops: NeonStage hotline +1-206-555-0100

Ryan from AcmeCorp will be joining us for a 30-minute partner walkthrough on Mon at 11:15 — Laura, please have the demo kit ready.

If no one flags travel swaps by 08:00 Fri, this becomes final; I’ll push rooming to hotels and send calendar invites.

Thanks, see you on site —
Monica
Field Events Coordinator, Redwood Inference
